regime_context:
BTC at 81,907, above EMA300 (81,634) for 70 candles. LEAN_BULL, STRONG_UP trend quality, but NEGATIVE acceleration and SLOW velocity — the uptrend is fading. Volume regime LOW. 15m scanner: LONG_BIAS (56 long vs 3 short across 124 tokens). 4h scanner: SHORT_BIAS. Market phase: DECLINING on 15m, CALM on continuum.

Implication: LONGs are regime-aligned on the 15m, but the 4h SHORT_BIAS and negative acceleration mean this is a fade-the-rip environment, not a buy-the-dip environment. Chasing strength will get punished. Mean-reversion entries (bb-bounce) are more likely to work than momentum breakouts. The oversold-long pattern (doji-bottom, oversold-bounce) is losing because the 4h downtrend keeps grinding lower — catching falling knives.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERNS (7d PostgreSQL, meta_rsi):

1. OVERSOLD LONGS ARE THE #1 MONEY LOSER — LONG entries at RSI<40: 26.7% WR (n=15), avg -0.041. The winning side was SHORT every time. Recent examples: APT RSI 33.7 → -4.2% (hard_max_loss), ZEN RSI 29.5 → -5.1%, CRV RSI 39.8 → -4.4%. Why weren't we on the SHORT side? doji-bottom-long and oversold-bounce signals are designed to catch falling knives. In a 4h SHORT_BIAS regime, the knife keeps falling. Fix: block LONG signals when meta_rsi < 40 AND 4h regime is SHORT_BIAS.

2. doji-bottom-long IS A NET LOSER — 17 trades in 7d, 35.3% WR, avg -0.044. Three consecutive losses in last 20 (ZEN, CRV, YGG). This signal fires at oversold RSI attempting bottom-calls. In the current regime, bottom-calls fail. The one win (GMT, RSI 56.2) was NOT oversold — it was center band. The signal works when RSI is 50+, not when RSI is 30.

3. OVERBOUGHT LONGS ARE FINE — LONG entries at RSI>65: 35% WR but avg +0.012 (net positive). Overbought SHORTS (n=2) were 100% WR — when RSI>65 AND we short, we win. The ALT SHORT at RSI 63.3 (+4.2%) confirms: fading overbought works.

4. CENTER-BAND SHORTS LOSE — SHORT entries at RSI 45-60: 18.2% WR (n=22), avg -0.045. Shorting mid-range in a LEAN_BULL regime is suicide. The winning side was LONG.

5. VOLUME SIGNALS ARE BROKEN — volume-breakout-long+ 17.6% WR (n=17!), volume-buildup+ 20% WR (n=5). These fire on volume spikes that mean-revert. Meanwhile volume-buildup- (SHORT) is 87.5% WR (n=8). Volume spikes are SHORT signals, not LONG signals, in this regime.

6. hl_copy_trader is mediocre — 37.5% WR (n=8), avg +0.002. Barely breakeven. The HYPE LONG currently open came from this signal at RSI 36.0 (oversold zone).
